$description: DiluxOne's WordPress admin design system, v0: what Offload's and Users+'s admin screens already use, mapped to the WordPress admin palette where they match. Read README.md for where each value came from.

color.$description: Colours. The palette first (WordPress's own admin colours, only those the plugins use), then what each colour is for. A screen uses the second kind, never the palette.

wp.$description: The WordPress admin palette (wp-admin/css/colors), the shades Offload and Users+ use.

$root.$description: Body text and titles. Users+ --du-text, Offload's titles.

muted.$description: Help text, labels of a key/value table. Users+ --du-muted, Offload's descriptions.

subtle.$description: Secondary text inside a filled shape (the off pill, a pill's reason). Both plugins.

$root.$description: Every card, field group and rule. Users+ --du-line; Offload's #dcdcde (and its #ddd, which maps here).

strong.$description: An edge that must hold against a grey ground (the action box, a tab strip). Both plugins.

soft.$description: A rule inside a box. Users+ --du-line-soft.

alt.$description: A box set apart (the main action, a locked choice). Users+ --du-ground-alt, Offload's action box.

$root.$description: The person's admin colour scheme: the plugin sets this property from the scheme (its third colour) on :root, on its own screens only: the properties built on it resolve there. The value here is the default scheme's, the fallback. Users+ --du-accent, Offload --diluxone-offload-accent.

light.$description: The scheme's fourth colour, its light companion. Users+ --du-accent-light.

wash.$description: The ground of something chosen: the accent at 8% on white, so a scheme change carries it along. Users+ --du-accent-wash.

edge.$description: The edge of a box under the pointer: the accent at 45% on white. Users+ --du-accent-edge.

$root.$description: Done, connected, in step: WordPress's notice-success. Both plugins.
Something that will bite: WordPress's amber. Users+ --du-warn, Offload's warnings.

text.$description: Amber that reads as text on white. Offload's pending counts.

strong.$description: A destructive button's hover, a danger link. Both plugins.

text.$description: Error text on its wash. Users+ used #8a1f21, a shade off the palette's red-70.

$root.$description: Everything else a screen has to say: no colour of its own, the scheme's (Users+ .du-notice--info).

pill.$description: The state vocabulary: one pill shape, three states, the same in Offload and Users+ to the hex value. Not in the WordPress palette; kept as they are.

$root.$description: A Pro add-on's badge: a colour of its own, so it never reads as one of the states. Users+ --du-pro.

space.$description: The space scale, Users+'s (--du-1 to --du-6); Offload's paddings, margins and gaps are the same numbers, but its 20px.

block.$description: The room under every block of a screen, one number for all of them. Users+ --du-block.

pill-block.$description: Above and below a pill's text. Both plugins (padding: 2px 10px).

pill-inline.$description: Either side of a pill's text. Both plugins.

sm.$description: Notices, fields, small boxes. Users+ --du-radius-sm, Offload's most used radius.

size.$description: The type scale. The family is never set: WordPress's admin stack is inherited.

tiny.$description: An eyebrow in capitals, a code reference in a list.

help.$description: WordPress's body size: help text, notes, tables. Users+ --du-help.

heading.$description: A section's heading. Users+ --du-heading, Offload's card titles.

semibold.$description: The only weight above regular either plugin uses (never bold).

snug.$description: A title in capitals on a card.

bar.$description: The accent band: the open tab's top, a card's top, the state box's top. Both plugins.

notice.$description: A notice's left bar, as WordPress draws its own.

raise.$description: A card under the pointer. Users+.

dialog.$description: A modal. Users+ (Offload's modal uses 0 10px 30px at 30%).

focus.$description: A focused field, as WordPress draws it, in the scheme's accent. Users+.

fast.$description: Every hover and state change. Users+ (.12s everywhere).

measure.$description: How wide something that is read gets: a column of options, a notice, a field. Both plugins (Offload's main column, Users+ --du-measure).

rail.$description: The narrowest the side rail gets before it goes under the content. Users+ --du-rail (Offload: 240px).

card-min.$description: The narrowest a card of a grid gets. Users+ .diluxone-users-cards.

toolbar.$description: WordPress's admin bar, for what sticks under it.

toolbar-mobile.$description: The admin bar below the mobile breakpoint.

breakpoint.$description: WordPress's own two, and no others: a custom property cannot be read by @media, so these are for people and tools to read; a stylesheet writes the number.

mobile.$description: Where WordPress switches the admin to touch.
